self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Crush (R5): Normal or Charged Attack hits have a 50% chance to deal an additional 480% ATK DMG to opponents in a small AoE. Can only occur once every 15s; modeled as a supplementary hit at the full proc value — its own rotation target (weapon/normalExtraHit + weapon/chargedExtraHit), weight = how many times it procs; physical, scales with ATK and CRIT only, no DMG% bonuses.
